description: Body of POST /vision/scanners/suggest_tags/ — the classifier config currently being edited.

allow_freeform_tags.description: Whether the classifier may emit tags outside the fixed vocabulary.

multi_label.description: Whether the classifier assigns multiple tags per session.

prompt.description: The classifier's instruction prompt — the single dimension to categorize sessions by.

scanner_id.description: Existing scanner to ground suggestions in its own observations (the tags and reasoning it has already produced on real recordings). Omit for an unsaved scanner.

tags.description: The categories already configured, so suggestions never duplicate one the user has.
